info.name: Jewellery Platform API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Jewellery Platform backend. Covers all Phase 1 + Phase 2 (DeliveryModule) endpoints.

Setup:
1. Import the companion environment file.
2. Run '00 Setup / Admin Login' first — it auto-saves {{adminToken}}.
3. Run 'Customer Login' and 'Agent Login' to populate the other tokens.
4. All subsequent requests inherit the correct token from the folder default.
